# ScoreWarpLoader { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader }

```python
loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader()
```

Load the time axis drawn into a ScoreWarp SVG.

The drawing becomes a :class:`ContinuousGraphicalTimeline` in
``css_pixels``, the unit of the SVG's outer viewport, and its time axis a
child over the drawn segment, carrying the C-Map from ``css_pixels`` to
the unit of the axis title, built through the labelled ticks (see
:meth:`~timetoalign.timelines.Timeline.create_calibrated_child`).

The drawing's length is its content extent, because a child lies within
its parent: the viewport width, or the end of the axis's farthest line
where the axis runs past the viewport (ScoreWarp sets
``overflow="visible"``).

Known limits: the extent of text is not counted, since no font metrics
are read, and nothing but the axis is read; the score's own elements and
the transforms that place them are left alone.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> loader = ScoreWarpLoader.from_file("warped.svg")
>>> drawing = loader.create_timeline()
>>> axis = drawing.get_child(drawing.list_children()[0])
>>> cmap = axis.get_conversion_map("seconds")
```

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [axis_segment](#timetoalign.loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader.axis_segment) | Start and end of the drawn horizontal axis line, in ``css_pixels``. |
| [calibration](#timetoalign.loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader.calibration) | ``(position, value)`` of every labelled tick, in label order. |
| [svg_size](#timetoalign.loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader.svg_size) | The root's ``width`` and ``height`` attributes, verbatim. |
| [ticks](#timetoalign.loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader.ticks) | The x of every tick line, in ``css_pixels`` and document order. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [clear](#timetoalign.loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader.clear) | Forget the loaded SVG. |
| [create_timeline](#timetoalign.loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader.create_timeline) | Create the drawing's timeline, its time axis as a calibrated child. |

### clear { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader.clear }

```python
loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader.clear()
```

Forget the loaded SVG.

### create_timeline { #timetoalign.loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader.create_timeline }

```python
loader.graphical.ScoreWarpLoader.create_timeline(uid=None, name=None)
```

Create the drawing's timeline, its time axis as a calibrated child.

The timeline is in ``css_pixels``, its length the content extent, its
``meta`` the root's size strings (``svg_width``, ``svg_height``). Its
one child is the axis: offset at the segment's start, length the
segment's, named by the title label, with the C-Map from
``css_pixels`` to the title's unit through the labelled ticks.

Both ids are minted ``cgt_N`` by this loader, the root first: its
number is drawn even when *uid* names it, and a given *uid* is
recorded among the loader's minted ids, so the child is never
minted the root's id and successive timelines share none.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                 | Description                                                                                               | Default   |
|--------|----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| uid    | [str](`str`) \| None | Unique identifier for the timeline. ``None`` mints ``cgt_N``, a number this loader has not minted before. | `None`    |
| name   | [str](`str`) \| None | Human-readable name. Uses the source file's stem if None.                                                 | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                               | Description             |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------|
|        | [ContinuousGraphicalTimeline](`timetoalign.timelines.ContinuousGraphicalTimeline`) | The drawing's timeline. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                           | Description                                                                    |
|--------|--------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [RuntimeError](`RuntimeError`) | If no SVG has been loaded.                                                     |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`)     | If the labelled ticks do not lie on one line, as the calibration check states. |
